address: LF, Dusit Thani Bangkok, 98 Rama IV Road, Silom, Bangrak, Bangkok, 10500, Thailand
bio: This restaurant brings refined Italian dining to Dusit Thani Bangkok. Implementing Bombana's vision, the Italian chef marries classical roots with modern technique in confident, well-balanced dishes. Choose a concise set lunch menu or the full dinner tasting experience. Featuring warm lighting and plush seating, the elegant room overlooks a calming waterfall. The 350-label wine cellar is overseen by a clued-up sommelier team....
